purpose: Deterministic image inventory for safe Hostinger migration. This file is discovery-only; it must not be used to infer a URL replacement by filename alone.

rules.legacy_themes_scope: Only /themes/... references, including absolute https://www.agemanagementmed.com/themes/... references, are migration candidates.
rules.legacy_target_url: For a legacy image, new_hostinger_url remains null until the upload script successfully uploads the exact image and returns its final Hostinger URL.
rules.public_scope: Project files under public/ are inventoried but are not assigned a Hostinger URL.
rules.external_scope: Cloudinary and other external image URLs are ignored for migration and must remain unchanged.
rules.replacement_rule: A future replacement must use image_id plus exact current_reference (or exact original_local_path) and must update only the matching source usages listed for that image_id.
rules.identity_rule: Never match or replace images by basename/filename alone. Use image_id and the exact reference/path recorded here.
rules.immutability_rule: image_id and the usage records are stable identifiers. Uploading new files may only populate new_hostinger_url; it must not reorder or reassign image_ids.

application_example.step_1: Find the image object by image_id.
application_example.step_2: Read new_hostinger_url. If null, do not change code.
application_example.step_3: For each usage, match the exact source_file + source_line + current_reference.
application_example.step_4: Replace only that exact current_reference with the image object's new_hostinger_url.
application_example.step_5: Never use filename-only matching, never replace similar images, and never update an unrelated occurrence.
application_example.step_6: After replacement, re-scan all usage locations and verify that the old reference is gone only where expected.

replacement_identity.replacement_allowed_when: new_hostinger_url is non-null AND upload_verified is true
